projects.title: Task Master Pro
projects.description: The project is a Todo App, which likely allows users to manage tasks by adding, filtering, and marking them as complete or incomplete. It is structured as a modern web application with reusable components and a focus on modularity.

projects.title: Anime Watchlist
projects.description: Anime Watchlist is a responsive web and Android application that helps users track, rate, and organize anime. Users can add series to their collection, assign ratings on a 0-10 scale, organize anime into tier rankings, and track their watch status. The app features both light and dark themes, and stores data locally with an optimized Android version that significantly reduces app size.

projects.title: School Website
projects.description: An informational school website showcasing the school's mission, programs, admissions, academic calendar, faculty profiles, photo gallery, news & events, and contact information. Built as a fast, accessible, mobile-first static site ready for deployment.

projects.title: Admin Dashboard
projects.description: A comprehensive admin dashboard for managing student fee collections and payments. Features real-time statistics, monthly collection analytics, payment status tracking, and a detailed transaction history. Includes interactive charts for data visualization and payment management.

projects.title: Draggable File Cards UI
projects.description: An interactive draggable card interface built with React, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion. Each card represents a file with dynamic tag colors, smooth drag animations, and responsive layout. The project focuses on modern UI interactions, reusable components, and physics-based motion effects.

bio.name: Dipesh Malla
bio.headline: Full Stack Developer
story: Hi, I'm Dipesh Malla, a full-stack developer from Nepal. I specialize in building modern web applications using React on the frontend and FastAPI on the backend. My passion lies in creating scalable and efficient solutions that deliver exceptional user experiences.

With 2 years of experience in web development, I've evolved from frontend development with React and JavaScript to mastering full-stack development. I work extensively with FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and PostgreSQL to build robust backend systems. I'm particularly passionate about creating clean, maintainable code and implementing efficient database solutions that power seamless user experiences.
bio.quote: When I'm not coding, you'll find me contributing to open-source, helping peers learn, or exploring the latest in web development technologies. I believe in lifelong learning, mentorship, and giving back to the tech community.
bio.homeIntro: I specialize in building modern web applications with React and Node.js, focusing on scalable solutions and exceptional user experiences.
